question: Which author released the memoir 'Mother Mary Comes to Me' in 2025, reflecting on her relationship with her late mother?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy**, an acclaimed Indian author, released the memoir "**Mother Mary Comes to Me**" in **2025**, reflecting on her relationship with her late mother.
 
• Arundhati Roy is widely known for her debut novel "**The God of Small Things**", which won the **Booker Prize** in **1997**.
 
• This memoir is a personal exploration of the emotional bond between her and her mother, drawing on memories, struggles, and shared experiences.
 
• Through the book, Roy delves into themes of family, identity, and love, making it a deeply moving literary work.
 
• It is considered a significant addition to her literary repertoire, showcasing her prowess in blending personal narrative with broader societal insights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy:**

 
 
• Born on **24 November 1961**, in **Shillong, Meghalaya**, India.
 
• Her debut novel "**The God of Small Things**" brought her global recognition and the prestigious **Booker Prize**.
 
• Besides her novels, Roy is also known for her **activism** and essays on various social and political issues.
 
• She has written works like "**Capitalism: A Ghost Story**" and "**Field Notes on Democracy**", which critique social injustices and inequalities.
 
 
 
• **Indian Authors and Memoirs:**
 
 
• **Jhumpa Lahiri:** A Pulitzer Prize-winning author, known for "**Interpreter of Maladies**", explores themes of identity and diaspora.
 
• **Kiran Desai:** Winner of the **2006 Booker Prize** for her novel "**The Inheritance of Loss**", her works often reflect cultural displacement and identity.
 
• **Anita Desai:** A prominent Indian novelist, known for "**Clear Light of Day**" and "**Fasting, Feasting**", her writings center around familial relationships and inner conflicts.
 
 
 
• **Memoirs by Indian Authors:**
 
 
• Memoirs are a popular genre among Indian authors, often used to share personal stories and historical accounts.
 
• Examples include "**My Experiments with Truth**" by **Mahatma Gandhi** and "**The Test of My Life**" by **Yuvraj Singh**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arundhati Roy’s Literary Style:**

 
 
• Roy is known for her **lyrical prose**, which often blends political insights with personal storytelling.
 
• Her works are celebrated for their **rich imagery**, strong character development, and poignant themes.
 
 
 
• **Recognition:**
 
 
• Her literary contributions have earned her numerous accolades, including the **Sydney Peace Prize** for her activism.
 
• She is recognized globally as a prominent voice advocating for social justice and equity.
